gitBaseline.note: Preserved unrelated local work; no reset/discard. Open Rides redesign changes remain uncommitted alongside other WIP.

auditFindings.finding: Initial flutter build apk --debug without ORA_ENV=staging hit Development default (api-dev / Vercel error). Blocked Open Rides.
auditFindings.fix: Rebuilt via staging dart-defines against .staging_api_url Cloud Run HTTPS base.

auditFindings.finding: PNG filenames did not match visual content (e.g. star.png=parcel, clock.png=shield, steering.png=route, decline_x.png=steering).
auditFindings.fix: Remapped icon files to match content; star replaced by Flutter Icons.star_rounded; parcel kept as parcel.png.

auditFindings.finding: All ride_card PNGs were indexed color with opaque near-black backgrounds (no tRNS).
auditFindings.fix: Converted to RGBA and chroma-keyed near-black (thr=22) to transparent. Backup under .e2e_artifacts/ride_card_asset_backup/.

auditFindings.finding: Map thumb overlaid PNG pins at fixed corners ignoring ride lat/lng while CustomPainter already projected real coordinates.
auditFindings.fix: Removed fixed PNG pin overlays; painter pins remain coordinate-aware.

auditFindings.finding: Physical card truncated duration to '21 ...' because car+fare competed with metrics for width.
auditFindings.fix: Moved RideCardMetrics to its own full-width row above car/category/fare.

auditFindings.finding: Decline must be UI-only without inventing an endpoint or permanent declined status.
auditFindings.fix: dismissRideLocally session-hides; cleared on refresh/loadInitial; no success banner. Covered by unit + physical tests.

auditFindings.finding: Full-resolution PNG decode for 12–76px display sizes.
